name: harness
title: Harness
description: Inspect harness state, select or relocate its root, initialize, migrate layout, read context, or clean history. Use /harness or /hn with list, root, init, migrate, context, or clean. Accepts legacy root/init/loc/context and management commands. Context summaries overlap with handoff; harness-link owns links. Owns retention; harness-timer schedules maintenance. Bare invocation only lists.
author: wzlwit

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: Primary action; omitted means read-only list. Compatibility aliases remain in SKILL.md. Operation-specific approvals still apply.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Existing parent/controller path for root. Omission only displays locations. Select a valid new path, then prompt to move an initialized previous harness; Move is the default, including no answer. Explicit answers or user instructions override it. A skipped or failed move keeps the new root selected. Invalid paths do not change Root.

inputs.name: current-file
inputs.description: Canonical current-<project>.csv filename. Init accepts it for a new controller; root with this option previews an explicit rename through Board. Existing files change only on approved --apply.
